# AI Income Lab

AI Income Lab is a private Skool community for people building practical AI systems for their business or clients.

## Key facts

- Plans start at $9 per month.
- The community has 3,000+ members.
- Membership includes courses, templates, curated tools, weekly support, and advanced workflows by plan.
- The guided path helps members build one useful AI system in 30 days.
